tagline: Redraw a photo as triangles — on this device, saved in the file.
description:
The photo and the reconstruction live in this file. Close it, open it later, the triangles are still there — not redrawn from scratch. Take a still or open a picture; nothing is sent anywhere.

This is the same algorithm as primitive.lol: add one triangle (or rectangle, ellipse, smiley) at a time until a picture appears. Hold the result to see the original. Quick / Classic / Fine pick how many shapes. Stop whenever the likeness is enough. Download a PNG or the SVG.

An unofficial port of primitive.js by Ondřej Žára.
